briefdescription.para: A component uses this to perform a set operation for multiple parameters at once. This method identifies the provider component of each parameter, groups them and makes the SET call per provider component. The given order is NOT maintained.

detaileddescription.para: This API ensures rolling back of all the property to previous value upon failure to set any single parameter in the given list. Used by: All components that need to set multiple parameters

parameterdescription.para: Bus Handle
The number (count) of parameters
The list of dml properties to set to. For each parameter, a property should be created which contains the parameter's name and the respective value to set that parameter to.
Extra options such as session info. Set NULL if not needed, in which case a session is not used and the set is commited immediately.
Timeout in milliseconds to be used for each SET per provider; Set to 0 to use the default value (15s).
Output parameter that represents the failed property. On success, it will returning NULL. Caller responsible to free() this.

simplesect.para: RBus error code as defined by rbusError_t. Possible values are: RBUS_ERROR_INVALID_INPUT: Given inputs are not correct. RBUS_ERROR_ACCESS_NOT_ALLOWED: Access to requested parameter is not permitted. RBUS_ERROR_DESTINATION_NOT_REACHABLE: Destination element was not reachable.

briefdescription.para: Component use this API to open direct connection to the provider.

detaileddescription.para: Rbus supports a mode that optimizes performance for very frequent, high data rate transfers or rbus operations that need extremely low latency. This is known as rbus_direct mode. While this mode improves performance, reduces CPU usage and improves latency, it also uses more memory and resources compared with normal rbus operation. Rbus_direct mode should only be used where it's needed and avoided where its not needed. Developers should use normal rbus operation modes unless there are special circumstances that require rbus_direct mode. Developers should NOT use rbus_direct mode for all operations. For more information on rbus_direct see the instructions for rbus_openDirect() in rbus.h.
Used by: Component that wants to use private connection to provider and avoid RBUS Daemon.

parameterdescription.para: Current active rbus handle
Direct handle that is created
Direct connection for the given parameter

simplesect.para: RBus error code as defined by rbusError_t.
